title: The Power of a Praying Woman
author: Stormie Omartian
target_audience: Individuals seeking spiritual growth or a deeper prayer life
Women facing life’s challenges and seeking faith-based guidance
Church groups and Bible study participants
core_themes: The transformative power of prayer in a woman’s life
Trust, surrender, and obedience to God’s will
primary_purpose: To encourage and empower women to cultivate a richer, more dynamic prayer life, finding strength, hope, and transformation by praying intentionally and regularly in all aspects of their lives.

structure_format.narrative_style: Personal, conversational, and empathetic; includes biblical references throughout
structure_format.organization: Divided into thematic chapters addressing various areas of a woman’s life (spiritual, emotional, relational, physical, etc.)
features: Personal reflections and anecdotes from the author
Sample prayers at the end of each chapter
Scripture verses relevant to each topic

key_concepts_lessons: Prayer deepens one’s connection with God and brings transformation.
Women can seek God’s guidance and comfort in every aspect of their lives—physical, emotional, relational, and spiritual.
Specific and focused prayers can address unique challenges women face.
Reading and praying God’s Word brings personal growth and healing.
Openness, honesty, and consistency in prayer lead to greater peace, purpose, and fulfillment.
Asking God to reveal, heal, and strengthen weak areas opens the door to spiritual renewal.
notable_features: Highly practical, with sample prayers for each topic
Rooted in biblical scripture and Christian tradition
Addresses real-life concerns unique to women
Widely used in women’s ministry groups, prayer meetings, and personal devotion
cultural_historical_context: Published in the early 2000s amidst a growing Christian women’s movement emphasizing honest spirituality, communal prayer, and practical faith. The book has become a staple in many contemporary evangelical circles.
reception_impact: Bestseller status, with millions of copies sold worldwide
Credited with helping countless women develop a regular prayer habit
Frequently recommended by pastors, church leaders, and Christian women’s organizations
Inspired a bestselling series (including The Power of a Praying Wife, Parent, etc.)
comparable_titles: The Power of a Praying Wife by Stormie Omartian
Becoming the Woman God Wants Me to Be by Donna Partow
A Woman After God’s Own Heart by Elizabeth George
Fervent: A Woman’s Battle Plan to Serious, Specific, and Strategic Prayer by Priscilla Shirer
